register.title: No free, key-less structured odds feed for darts
register.what_was_checked: OLBG darts index (2026-09-03), PDC.tv, Wikipedia event pages, ESPN site API (no darts coverage), The Odds API requires a key.
register.finding: OLBG server-rendered pages expose tipster vote counts, never prices. PDC/Wikipedia publish no price data. No public key-less price feed exists.
register.effect_on_output: The 25-pt Odds Strength component is recorded as missing on every live card; Step 3's price-gated rules (Full Bet / Small Bet / profitability check) resolve to SKIP; written verdicts and confidence are still produced from sourced factors; HIGH is impossible on a live card.

register.title: 3-dart averages are only stored when the source prints them
register.what_was_checked: Wikipedia 2026 Hungarian Darts Trophy match reports and draw (fetched 2026-09-03).
register.finding: Averages are printed for a minority of matches (e.g. Cross 101.90 / Greaves 104.88, van Duijvenbode 90.71 / Písek 77.24, Smith 101.01 in the final). Most rows have no average.
register.effect_on_output: The 20-pt 3-dart average component is missing unless the tape row carries average_a / average_b. Career or estimated averages are never invented.

register.title: PDC.tv player and ranking pages are JS-rendered
register.finding: Official PDC pages hydrate in the browser. Static HTML is not a usable ranking table.
register.effect_on_output: The Order of Merit snapshot is taken from dartsrankings.com (public table dated 30 August 2026, after ET11), with PDC.tv kept as a review link. Ranks are never guessed.

register.title: No key-less PDC results/averages API
register.what_was_checked: PDC.tv, dartconnect, ESPN site API sports index, Wikipedia.
register.finding: There is no public key-less JSON results/averages feed. The registry previously marked darts unpredictable for this reason.
register.effect_on_output: The specialist layer scores from a committed, source-tagged tape transcribed from Wikipedia match reports plus the public Order of Merit table. Checkout percentage, 180s rate and first-9 average have no free source and are not scored at all.

register.title: Incomplete later-round scores are omitted, never reconstructed
register.what_was_checked: Wikipedia 2026 Hungarian Darts Trophy first-round, second-round and final-day reports.
register.finding: First round (16 matches) is complete. Several second-round and later matches have printed scores; others are described only by seed-exit labels (e.g. Wattimena reached the third round) without a score.
register.effect_on_output: Unscored matches are absent from the tape. Seed-exit labels are never turned into 6–x results. The backtest therefore grades only the printed matches.

register.title: Czech Darts Open first-round draw is not yet published
register.what_was_checked: Wikipedia 2026 Czech Darts Open (fetched 2026-09-03); OLBG darts index.
register.finding: The event is scheduled 4–6 September 2026 at PVA Expo Prague. Host-nation qualifier is listed as 3 September. The fetched Wikipedia page has the seeded field but no first-round pairings. OLBG carried only outright tournament markets.
register.effect_on_output: No Czech Open match is invented. The live slate has outrights for display only. Historical leans are written against the Hungarian tape until pairings exist.

register.title: Checkout %, 180s and first-9 average have no free structured source
register.what_was_checked: Wikipedia match reports, PDC.tv, OLBG, dartsrankings.com.
register.finding: Isolated checkout mentions exist (Cross 170, Dobey 170, Smith 73% doubles in the final) but there is no per-player checkout or 180s table.
register.effect_on_output: Those prompt inputs are not scored. They do not appear as zero-tiered components; they are simply absent from the model.
